streamtest: procedure
parse arg n, expected
hex = copies('61',n)
header = right(d2x(n),8,'0')
'MAKEBUF'
queue header
do while length(hex) > 128
   queue left(hex,128)
   hex = substr(hex,129)
end
if length(hex) > 0 then queue hex
'GITSTRM'
strc = rc
if strc \= 0 then do
   'DROPBUF'
   say 'BOUNDARY' n 'GITSTRM RC=' strc
   return strc
end
pull got
'DROPBUF'
say 'BOUNDARY' n 'OID=' got
if got \= expected then do
   say 'BOUNDARY' n 'EXPECTED=' expected
   return 8
end
return 0

/* Hash an exact Git object body with GITSTRM. */
hashobject: procedure
   parse arg type, bodyhex
   bodylen = length(bodyhex) % 2
   /* REXX decimal digits are EBCDIC; Git header digits must be ASCII. */
   dec = bodylen
   dechex = ''
   do i = 1 to length(dec)
      dechex = dechex || d2x(c2d(substr(dec,i,1))-240+48,2)
   end
   if type = 'tree' then prefixhex = '7472656520' || dechex || '00'
   else if type = 'commit' then prefixhex = '636F6D6D697420' || dechex || '00'
   else return 'BADTYPE'
   streamhex = prefixhex || bodyhex
   total = length(streamhex) % 2
   header = right(d2x(total),8,'0')
   'MAKEBUF'
   if rc < 0 then return 'MAKEBUF'
   queue header
   pos = 1
   do while pos <= length(streamhex)
      remain = length(streamhex) - pos + 1
      take = min(128,remain)
      queue substr(streamhex,pos,take)
      pos = pos + take
   end
   'GITSTRM'
   src = rc
   if src \= 0 then do
      'DROPBUF'
      return 'GITSTRM'
   end
   if queued() \= 1 then do
      'DROPBUF'
      return 'STACK'
   end
   pull oid
   'DROPBUF'
   return oid

storeobject: procedure
   parse arg oid, type, datahex
   objfn = substr(oid,1,8)
   obj.0 = 3
   obj.1 = 'OID' oid
   obj.2 = 'TYPE' type
   obj.3 = 'DATA' datahex
   'EXECIO' obj.0 'DISKW' objfn 'GITOBJ A 1 (STEM OBJ. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then do
      say 'M4STORE: cannot store' type 'object' oid
      return rc
   end
   return 0

checkobject: procedure
   parse arg oid, type, datahex
   objfn = substr(oid,1,8)
   drop chk.
   'EXECIO * DISKR' objfn 'GITOBJ A 1 (STEM CHK. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then do
      say 'M4STORE: cannot reread object' oid
      return rc
   end
   if chk.0 \= 3 | chk.1 \= 'OID' oid | chk.2 \= 'TYPE' type |,
      chk.3 \= 'DATA' datahex then do
      say 'M4STORE: stored object verification failed' oid
      return 8
   end
   return 0

streamtest: procedure
   parse arg hex, expected
   total = length(hex) % 2
   /* GITSTRM protocol requires exactly eight EBCDIC hex digits. */
   header = right(d2x(total),8,'0')
   say 'M4: STREAM BYTES=' total 'HEADER=' header
   'MAKEBUF'
   if rc < 0 then do
      say 'M4: cannot create program-stack buffer'
      return 4
   end
   queue header
   pos = 1
   do while pos <= length(hex)
      /* REXX SUBSTR pads to an explicitly requested length.  Never ask */
      /* for 128 characters on the final short chunk: those blanks are */
      /* data to LINERD and would make a 42-byte stream look 64 bytes. */
      remain = length(hex) - pos + 1
      take = min(128,remain)
      queue substr(hex,pos,take)
      pos = pos + take
   end
   'GITSTRM'
   strmrc = rc
   if strmrc \= 0 then do
      'DROPBUF'
      say 'M4: GITSTRM RC=' strmrc
      return strmrc
   end
   if queued() \= 1 then do
      'DROPBUF'
      say 'M4: expected exactly one returned object ID'
      return 8
   end
   pull oid
   'DROPBUF'
   say 'OID=' oid
   if oid \= expected then do
      say 'M4: expected' expected
      return 8
   end
   return 0

files.GITP9KWK.EXEC:
/* M9K bounded ordinary PACK walker using streaming zlib output. */
parse upper arg command extra
if command \= 'WALK' | extra \= '' then do
   say 'Usage: GITP9KWK WALK'
   exit 4
end
address command
call readhex 0,12
if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
hdr = result
if substr(hdr,1,8) \= '5041434B' then do
   say 'GITP9KWK: bad PACK signature'
   exit 8
end
version = x2d(substr(hdr,9,8))
objects = x2d(substr(hdr,17,8))
if version \= 2 then exit 8
pos = 12
do entry = 1 to objects
   entrypos = pos
   call readbyte pos
   if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   b = result
   pos = pos + 1
   type = (b % 16) // 8
   size = b // 16
   shift = 4
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      call readbyte pos
      if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
      b = result
      pos = pos + 1
      size = size + (b // 128) * (2 ** shift)
      shift = shift + 7
      more = b >= 128
   end
   if type \= 3 then do
      say 'GITP9KWK: M9K supports ordinary blobs only'
      exit 8
   end
   'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
   if rc \= 0 then exit rc
   if queued() < 2 then exit 8
   parse pull used
   parse pull outlen
   if outlen \= size then do
      say 'GITP9KWK: inflated size mismatch'
      exit 8
   end
   'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
   if rc \= 0 | queued() < 1 then exit 8
   parse pull oid
   say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE BLOB SIZE' size
   say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
   say 'OBJECT OID' oid
   pos = pos + used
end
say 'PACK VERSION' version
say 'PACK OBJECTS' objects
say 'PACK DATA END' pos
exit 0
readbyte:
   parse arg offset
   call readhex offset,1
   if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   return x2d(result)
readhex:
   parse arg offset,count
   'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' offset count
   if rc \= 0 | queued() < 1 then return 'ERROR'
   parse pull h

/* M9L bounded OFS_DELTA PACK walker, isolated from M9K. */
parse upper arg command extra
if command \= 'WALK' | extra \= '' then exit 4
address command
call readhex 0,12
if result='ERROR' then exit 8
hdr=result
if substr(hdr,1,8)\='5041434B' then exit 8
version=x2d(substr(hdr,9,8)); objects=x2d(substr(hdr,17,8))
if version\=2 then exit 8
pos=12
basepos=-1
do entry=1 to objects
 entrypos=pos
 call readbyte pos
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 b=result; pos=pos+1
 type=(b%16)//8
 size=b//16; shift=4; more=b>=128
 do while more
  call readbyte pos
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  b=result; pos=pos+1
  size=size+(b//128)*(2**shift)
  shift=shift+7; more=b>=128
 end

  'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull outlen
  if outlen\=size then exit 8
  call savebase outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8

  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE BLOB SIZE' size
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else if type=6 then do
  c=0
  do forever
   call readbyte pos
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   b=result; pos=pos+1
   if c=0 then dist=b//128
   else dist=((dist+1)*128)+(b//128)
   c=c+1
   if b<128 then leave
  end
  want=entrypos-dist
  if want\=basepos then do
   say 'GITP9LWK: OFS base not available'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc

  parse pull dlen
  /* PACK size on a delta entry is delta-program size. */
  if dlen\=size then do
   say 'GITP9LWK: inflated delta size mismatch'
   exit 8
  end

  parse pull outlen
  call installout outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen

  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE OFS SIZE' size
  say 'BASE POSITION' want
  say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used

end

  basepos=entrypos
  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  baseoid=oid
  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE BLOB SIZE' size
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else if type=7 then do
  call readhex pos,20
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  wantoid=result
  pos=pos+20
  if wantoid\=baseoid then do
   say 'GITP9MWK: REF base not available'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull dlen
  if dlen\=size then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBDAPP APPLY'
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull outlen
  call installout outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE REF SIZE' size
  say 'BASE OID' wantoid
  say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else if type=6 then do
  c=0
  do forever
   call readbyte pos
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   b=result; pos=pos+1
   if c=0 then dist=b//128
   else dist=((dist+1)*128)+(b//128)
   c=c+1
   if b<128 then leave
  end
  want=entrypos-dist
  if want\=basepos then do
   say 'GITP9MWK: OFS base not available'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull dlen
  /* PACK size on a delta entry is delta-program size. */
  if dlen\=size then do
   say 'GITP9MWK: inflated delta size mismatch'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITBDAPP APPLY'
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull outlen
  call installout outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE OFS SIZE' size
  say 'BASE POSITION' want
  say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else exit 8
end
say 'PACK VERSION' version
say 'PACK OBJECTS' objects
say 'PACK DATA END' pos
exit 0
savebase:
 parse arg n
 'ERASE GITBASE DATA A'
 off=0
 do while off<n
  take=n-off
  if take>64 then take=64
  'EXEC GITOBUF READSTACK' off take
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  parse pull h
  r.1=h; r.0=1
  'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBASE DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  off=off+take
 end
 m.1='META' n '- 1'; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
installout:
 parse arg n
 'EXEC GITOBUF INIT'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop r.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITOUT DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 do i=1 to r.0
  'EXEC GITOBUF APPEND' strip(r.i)
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 'EXEC GITOBUF FINAL'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
readbyte:
 parse arg off
 call readhex off,1
 if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 return x2d(result)
readhex:
 parse arg off,n
 'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' off n
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 parse pull h
 if length(h)\=n*2 then return 'ERROR'
 return translate(h)

files.GITACK.EXEC:
/* M6D isolated Git v0/v1 fetch ACK/NAK response parser. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'PARSE' then do
   parse var rest payload extra
   if payload = '' | extra \= '' | length(payload) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(translate(payload),'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITACK PARSE payload-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   /* Git ACK/NAK payloads end in ASCII LF.  Remove that wire byte before
    * ASCII-to-CMS text conversion; LF is outside our printable translation. */
   if length(payload) >= 2 & translate(right(payload,2)) = '0A' then do
      payload = left(payload,length(payload)-2)
   end
   text = asciitocms(payload)
   if text = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   if text = 'NAK' then do
      say 'NAK'
      exit 0
   end
   parse var text word oid status extra
   word = translate(word)
   oid = translate(oid)
   status = translate(status)
   if word \= 'ACK' | \ validsha1(oid) | extra \= '' then do
      say 'GITACK: invalid ACK/NAK payload'
      exit 8
   end
   if status = '' then do
      say 'ACK' oid
      exit 0
   end
   if status \= 'CONTINUE' & status \= 'COMMON' & status \= 'READY' then do
      say 'GITACK: invalid ACK status' status
      exit 8
   end
   say 'ACK' oid status
   exit 0
end

say 'GITACK: unknown command' command
exit 4

/* M6B isolated Git v0/v1 ref-advertisement parser. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'PARSE' then do
   parse var rest datahex extra
   if datahex = '' | extra \= '' | length(datahex) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(translate(datahex),'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITADV PARSE payload-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   nul = bytepos('00',datahex)
   if nul > 0 then do
      mainhex = substr(datahex,1,nul-1)
      caphex = substr(datahex,nul+2)
   end
   else do
      mainhex = datahex
      caphex = ''
   end
   sp = bytepos('20',mainhex)
   if sp \= 41 then do
      say 'GITADV: invalid advertised ref payload'
      exit 8
   end
   oidhex = translate(substr(mainhex,1,40))
   if verify(oidhex,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'GITADV: invalid object-id'
      exit 8
   end
   refhex = substr(mainhex,43)
   if refhex = '' then do
      say 'GITADV: missing ref name'
      exit 8
   end
   refname = asciitocms(refhex)
   if refname = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   if pos(' ',refname) > 0 then do
      say 'GITADV: invalid ref name'
      exit 8
   end
   say 'OID' oidhex
   say 'REF' refname
   if caphex \= '' then do
      caps = asciitocms(caphex)
      if caps = 'ERROR' then exit 8
      say 'CAPS' caps
   end
   exit 0
end
say 'GITADV: unknown command' command
exit 4

files.GITZLIB.EXEC:
/* M7B isolated RFC 1950 zlib wrapper parser. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'PARSE' then do
   parse var rest data extra
   data = translate(data)
   if extra \= '' | data = '' | length(data) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(data,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITZLIB PARSE zlib-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   if length(data) < 12 then do
      say 'GITZLIB: zlib stream too short'
      exit 8
   end
   cmf = x2d(substr(data,1,2))
   flg = x2d(substr(data,3,2))
   cm = cmf // 16
   cinfo = cmf % 16
   if cm \= 8 then do
      say 'GITZLIB: unsupported compression method' cm
      exit 8
   end
   if cinfo > 7 then do
      say 'GITZLIB: invalid DEFLATE window size'
      exit 8
   end
   if (cmf * 256 + flg) // 31 \= 0 then do
      say 'GITZLIB: invalid FCHECK'
      exit 8
   end
   fdict = (flg % 32) // 2
   flevel = flg % 64
   pos = 5
   if fdict then do
      if length(data) < 20 then do
         say 'GITZLIB: truncated preset dictionary identifier'
         exit 8
      end
      dictid = substr(data,pos,8)
      pos = pos + 8
   end
   else dictid = '-'
   trailer = length(data) - 7
   if pos > trailer then do
      say 'GITZLIB: missing DEFLATE payload'
      exit 8
   end
   deflate = substr(data,pos,trailer-pos)
   adler = substr(data,trailer,8)
   say 'CM' cm
   say 'CINFO' cinfo
   say 'FDICT' fdict
   say 'FLEVEL' flevel
   say 'DICTID' dictid
   say 'DEFLATE' deflate
   say 'ADLER32' adler
   exit 0
end

say 'GITZLIB: unknown command' command
exit 4

/* M10 bounded side-band pkt-line state machine. */
parse upper arg cmd hex extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 'ERASE G10META DATA A'
 call putmeta 'HDR','-',0,'-'
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 'EXEC GITPBUF INIT'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex
 do while work\=''
  if phase='HDR' then do
   need=8-length(hdr)
   take=length(work)
   if take>need then take=need
   hdr=hdr||left(work,take)
   work=substr(work,take+1)
   if length(hdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen hdr
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   n=result
   hdr=''
   if n=0 | n=1 | n=2 then iterate
   if n<5 then exit 8
   remain=n-4
   phase='BAND'
  end
  else if phase='BAND' then do
   if length(work)<2 then do
    say 'GIT10BF: odd internal band byte'
    exit 8
   end
   band=left(work,2)
   work=substr(work,3)
   remain=remain-1
   if band\='01' & band\='02' & band\='03' then exit 8
   if band='03' then exit 8
   if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
   else phase='PAY'
  end
  else if phase='PAY' then do
   bytes=length(work)%2
   take=bytes
   if take>remain then take=remain
   if take>64 then take=64
   if band='01' & take>0 then do
    'EXEC GITPBUF APPEND' left(work,take*2)
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
   end
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   remain=remain-take
   if remain=0 then do
    phase='HDR'; band='-'
   end
  end
  else exit 8
 end
 call putmeta phase,hdr,remain,band
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if phase\='HDR' | hdr\='' then do
  say 'GIT10BF: incomplete pkt-line at FINAL'
  exit 8
 end
 'EXEC GITPBUF FINAL'
 exit rc
end
exit 4
getmeta:
 drop m.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR G10META DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | m.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 parse var m.1 tag phase h remain band extra
 if tag\='META' | extra\='' then return 'ERROR'
 if h='-' then hdr=''
 else hdr=h
 return 'OK'
putmeta:
 parse arg p,h,r,b
 if h='' then h='-'
 m.1='META' p h r b; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G10META DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

 parse arg h
 n=0
 do i=1 to 4
  b=x2d(substr(h,i*2-1,2))
  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n

/* M10A incremental Git side-band PACK feeder. */
parse upper arg cmd hex extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 if hex\='' then exit 4
 'EXEC GITPBUF INIT'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 do while hex\=''
  if length(hex)<8 then exit 8
  call pktlen substr(hex,1,8)
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  n=result
  if n=0 then do
   hex=substr(hex,9)
   iterate
  end
  if n<5 then exit 8
  bytes=n-4
  need=n*2
  if length(hex)<need then exit 8
  data=substr(hex,9,bytes*2)
  band=substr(data,1,2)
  if band='01' then do
   p=substr(data,3)
   do while p\=''
    take=length(p)%2
    if take>64 then take=64
    h=substr(p,1,take*2)
    'EXEC GITPBUF APPEND' h
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
    p=substr(p,take*2+1)
   end
  end
  else if band='02' then nop
  else if band='03' then do
   say 'GIT10PK: remote fatal side-band'
   exit 8
  end
  else exit 8
  hex=substr(hex,need+1)
 end
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 if hex\='' then exit 4
 'EXEC GITPBUF FINAL'
 exit rc
end
exit 4

 parse arg h
 n=0

  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n

/* M10 bounded upload-pack response parser. */
parse upper arg cmd hex extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 'ERASE G10CMT DATA A'
 call putmeta 'PRE','HDR','-',0,'-'
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 'EXEC GIT10BF INIT'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex

  if phase='HDR' then do
   need=8-length(hdr)
   take=length(work)
   if take>need then take=need
   hdr=hdr||left(work,take)
   work=substr(work,take+1)
   if length(hdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen hdr
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   n=result
   if n=0 | n=1 | n=2 then do
    hdr=''
    iterate
   end
   if n<4 then exit 8
   remain=n-4
   if state='PACK' then do
    'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' hdr
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
    hdr=''
    phase='PASS'
   end
   else do
    prehdr=hdr
    hdr=''
    pre=''
    phase='PREPAY'
   end
  end
  else if phase='PASS' then do
   bytes=length(work)%2
   take=bytes
   if take>remain then take=remain
   if take>64 then take=64
   if take>0 then do
    'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' left(work,take*2)
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
   end
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   remain=remain-take
   if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
  end
  else if phase='PREPAY' then do
   bytes=length(work)%2
   take=bytes
   if take>remain then take=remain
   if take>5 then take=5
   pre=pre||left(work,take*2)
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   remain=remain-take
   if length(pre)>=2 & left(pre,2)='01' then do
    state='PACK'
    call passpre prehdr,pre
    if result='ERROR' then exit 8

    if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
    else phase='PASS'
   end
   else if length(pre)>=2 &,
      (left(pre,2)='02' | left(pre,2)='03') then do
    state='PACK'
    call passpre prehdr,pre
    if result='ERROR' then exit 8
    pre=''
    if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
    else phase='PASS'
   end
   else if remain=0 then do
    if pre\='4E414B0A' then do
     say 'GIT10UP: unexpected pre-PACK pkt-line'
     exit 8
    end
    pre=''
    phase='HDR'
   end
  end
  else exit 8
 end
 if phase='PREPAY' then hdr=prehdr
 call putmeta state,phase,hdr,remain,pre
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if state\='PACK' | phase\='HDR' | hdr\='' then exit 8
 'EXEC GIT10BF FINAL'
 exit rc
end
exit 4

 return 'OK'

 if rc\=0 | m.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'

 if tag\='META' | extra\='' then return 'ERROR'

/* M12I bounded HTTP/1.1 chunk decoder. */

end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if mode\='' | extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex
 do while work\=''
  if state='SIZE' then do
   b=left(work,2)
   work=substr(work,3)
   line=line||b
   if length(line)>32 then exit 8
   if right(line,4)='0D0A' then do
    hs=left(line,length(line)-4)
    if hs='' | verify(hs,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
    need=0
    do j=1 to length(hs) by 2
     v=x2d(substr(hs,j,2))
     if v>=48 & v<=57 then n=v-48
     else if v>=65 & v<=70 then n=v-55
     else if v>=97 & v<=102 then n=v-87
     else exit 8
     need=need*16+n
    end
    line=''
    if need=0 then state='DONE'
    else state='DATA'
   end
  end
  else if state='DATA' then do
   avail=length(work)%2

   if take>avail then take=avail

   work=substr(work,take*2+1)

   b=left(work,2)

   end

  else exit 8

end

/* M9P bounded context: one data file plus sequential index. */
parse upper arg cmd key oid n otype extra
address command

 r.1='NEXT 1 0'; r.0=1

end
if cmd='SAVE' then do
 if extra\='' | datatype(key,'W')\=1 | datatype(n,'W')\=1 then exit 4
 if otype='' then otype='BLOB'
 drop r.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | r.0\=1 then exit 8
 parse var r.1 word start idxrec
 if word\='NEXT' | datatype(start,'W')\=1 then exit 8
 if datatype(idxrec,'W')\=1 then idxrec=0
 off=0; nrec=0
 /* Copy validated object records directly in bounded 16-record batches. */
 /* Avoid one nested REXX EXEC per 64-byte record during SAVE. */
 drop om.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITOMETA DATA A 1 (STEM OM. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | om.0\=1 then exit 8
 parse var om.1 otag osize otail ofinal oextra
 if otag\='META' | osize\=n | otail\='-' |,
  ofinal\='1' | oextra\='' then exit 8
 do while off<n
  first=off%64+1
  batch=(n-off+63)%64
  if batch>16 then batch=16
  drop r.
  'EXECIO' batch 'DISKR GITOBUF DATA A' first,
   '(STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | r.0\=batch then exit 8
  do j=1 to batch
   h=strip(r.j)
   expected=n-off-(j-1)*64
   if expected>64 then expected=64
   if length(h)\=expected*2 |,
    verify(h,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
   r.j=h
  end
  'EXECIO' batch 'DISKW G9CDATA DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then exit 8

  off=off+batch*64
 end
 r.1=key oid n otype start nrec; r.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G9CIDX DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 r.1='NEXT' start+nrec idxrec+1; r.0=1

end

 rec=1; found=0
 if cmd='LOADPOS' then do
  drop z.
  'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM Z. FINIS'
  if rc=0 & z.0=1 then do
   parse var z.1 ztag znext zcount

     drop r.

     if rc\=0 | r.0\=1 then leave
     parse var r.1 p o sz typ first count
     if p=key then found=1
     else if p<key then leave
     else rec=rec-1
    end
   end
  end
  if found then rec=0
  else rec=1
 end

  drop r.
  'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CIDX DATA A' rec '(STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | r.0=0 then leave
  parse var r.1 p o sz typ first count
  if (cmd='LOADPOS' & p=key) | (cmd='LOADOID' & o=key) then found=1
  rec=rec+1
 end
 if \found then exit 8
 'ERASE GITBASE DATA A'
 /* Read and copy contiguous base records in bounded 16-record batches. */
 i=0
 do while i<count
  batch=count-i
  if batch>16 then batch=16

  src=first+i

   '(STEM Q. FINIS'

  if rc\=0 then exit 8
  i=i+batch
 end
 m.1='META' sz '- 1'; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 queue p
 queue o
 queue sz
 queue typ
 exit 0
end
exit 4

test_m13vrecs:
 procedure
/* M13V: native multi-record input and output, stored DEFLATE. */
/* 130 ASCII A bytes force 3 output records and 3 input records. */
address command
n = 130
plain = copies('41',n)
/* Adler32 of n copies of byte 65: s1=1+65*n; */
/* s2=n+65*n*(n+1)/2, both modulo 65521. */
s1 = (1 + 65*n) // 65521
s2 = (n + 65*n*(n+1)%2) // 65521
adler = d2x(s2,4)||d2x(s1,4)
/* zlib 78 01, final stored block 01, LEN=0082, NLEN=FF7D. */
stream = '78010182007DFF'||plain||adler
if length(stream)%2 \= 141 then do
 say 'M13V: internal fixture length mismatch'
 return 8
end
'EXEC GITPBUF INIT'
if rc \= 0 then return rc
do p = 1 to length(stream) by 128
 'EXEC GITPBUF APPEND' substr(stream,p,128)
 if rc \= 0 then return rc
end
'EXEC GITPBUF FINAL'
if rc \= 0 then return rc
'EXEC GITPZNAT TOOBUF 0 NATIVE'
if rc \= 0 | queued() < 2 then return 8
parse pull used
parse pull decoded
if used \= 141 | decoded \= n then do
 say 'M13V: incorrect native counts' used decoded
 return 8
end
/* Read in bounded chunks: a 260-character hex stack line can */
/* exceed the CMS/REXX external data-queue record limit. */
do offset = 0 to 128 by 64
 take = 64
 if offset + take > n then take = n - offset
 'EXEC GITOBUF READSTACK' offset take
 if rc \= 0 | queued() < 1 then return 8
 parse pull got
 want = substr(plain,offset*2+1,take*2)
 if got \= want then do
  say 'M13V: output mismatch at chunk offset' offset
  say 'M13V: expected chars' length(want) 'actual chars' length(got)
  do i = 1 to length(want) by 2
   if substr(got,i,2) \= substr(want,i,2) then do
    say 'M13V: first mismatch byte' offset+(i+1)%2,
        'expected' substr(want,i,2) 'got' substr(got,i,2)
    leave
   end
  end
  return 8
 end
end
say 'M13V NATIVE MULTI-RECORD STORED DEFLATE PASSED'
return 0

files.M173DCHK.EXEC:
/* M173: safe one-line MAINT directory delta checker. */
/* Read-only: never display directory source or passwords. */
address cms
parse upper arg extra
if strip(extra)\='' then do
 say 'Usage: M173DCHK'
 exit 4
end
'STATE USER DIRECT C'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR ORIGINAL MISSING'
 exit 8
end
'STATE M173BAK DIRECT C'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR BACKUP MISSING'
 exit 8
end
'STATE M173NEW DIRECT C'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR CANDIDATE MISSING'
 exit 8
end
drop u. b. n.
'EXECIO * DISKR USER DIRECT C 1 (STEM U. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR ORIGINAL READ FAIL'
 exit 8
end
'EXECIO * DISKR M173BAK DIRECT C 1 (STEM B. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR BACKUP READ FAIL'
 exit 8
end
'EXECIO * DISKR M173NEW DIRECT C 1 (STEM N. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR CANDIDATE READ FAIL'
 exit 8
end
if u.0\=4282 | b.0\=u.0 | n.0\=u.0+1 then do
 say 'M173 DIR RECORD COUNT FAIL'
 exit 8
end
/* Verify the untouched original against its backup. */
do i=1 to u.0
 if u.i\==b.i then do
  say 'M173 DIR BACKUP CONTENT MISMATCH'
  exit 8
 end
end
/* CP vdev 600 and 0600 are the same hexadecimal number. */
/* Use strict string checks to avoid REXX numeric = ambiguity. */
found=0
added=0
do i=1 to n.0
 w1=translate(word(n.i,1))
 w2=word(n.i,2)
 if w1=='MDISK' & (w2=='600' | w2=='0600') then do
  found=found+1
  added=i
 end
end
if found\=1 then do
 say 'M173 DIR VDEV 0600 ENTRY COUNT' found
 exit 8
end
/* Seven tokens exactly; only a leading zero on vdev is optional. */
valid=1
if words(n.added)\=7 then valid=0
if translate(word(n.added,1))\=='MDISK' then valid=0
v=word(n.added,2)
if v\=='600' & v\=='0600' then valid=0
if word(n.added,3)\=='3390' then valid=0
if word(n.added,4)\=='6000' then valid=0
if word(n.added,5)\=='1600' then valid=0
if translate(word(n.added,6))\=='VMCOM1' then valid=0
if translate(word(n.added,7))\=='W' then valid=0
if valid\=1 then do
 say 'M173 DIR MDISK FIELDS INVALID'
 exit 8
end
if added<2 | added>u.0 then do
 say 'M173 DIR INSERT POSITION INVALID'
 exit 8
end
/* One inserted line: all other source records must be unchanged. */
do i=1 to u.0
 j=i
 if i>=added then j=i+1
 if u.i\==n.j then do
  say 'M173 DIR OTHER CHANGE AT RECORD' i
  say 'M173 DIR CANDIDATE EXTRA CHANGE'
  exit 8
 end
end
/* SSI-ready MAINT is IDENTITY plus BUILD ON and SUBCONFIG. */
/* A subconfig MDISK need not follow an IDENTITY heading. */
sect=''
sid=''
inmaint=0
builds=0
do i=1 to added-1
 a=translate(word(u.i,1))
 b=translate(word(u.i,2))
 if a=='IDENTITY' | a=='USER' |,
    a=='SUBCONFIG' | a=='PROFILE' then do
  sect=a
  sid=b
  inmaint=0
  if a=='IDENTITY' & b=='MAINT' then inmaint=1
 end
 if inmaint=1 & a=='BUILD' then do
  if translate(word(u.i,2))=='ON' &,
     word(u.i,3)=='*' &,
     translate(word(u.i,4))=='USING' &,
     translate(word(u.i,5))=='SUBCONFIG' &,
     translate(word(u.i,6))=='MAINT-1' then builds=builds+1
 end
end
if sect\=='SUBCONFIG' | sid\=='MAINT-1' then do
 say 'M173 DIR WRONG ENCLOSING SUBCONFIG'
 exit 8
end
if builds\=1 then do
 say 'M173 DIR MAINT BUILD REFERENCE INVALID'
 exit 8
end
say 'M173 DIR ORIGINAL/BACKUP VERIFIED' u.0
say 'M173 DIR MAINT-1 SUBCONFIG VERIFIED'
say 'M173 DIR SINGLE MDISK INSERT RECORD' added
say 'M173 DIR DELTA CHECK PASS'
exit 0

'FILEDEF IDXIN DISK' idx 'INDEX' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'M176 IDXIN FILEDEF FAIL'
 exit 8
end

drop c.
c.0=0
'PIPE CMS GITPCAT INFO' moid '| STEM c.'
crc=rc
if crc\=0 then do
 do i=1 to c.0
  say c.i
 end
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'M176 COMMIT INFO FAIL RC' crc
 exit 8
end
tree=''
ctype=''
cpass=0
do i=1 to c.0
 say c.i
 if word(c.i,1)='PACKOBJ' & word(c.i,2)='OBJ' &,
    word(c.i,4)='TYPE' & words(c.i)=7 then,
    ctype=word(c.i,5)
 if word(c.i,1)='PACKOBJ' & word(c.i,2)='COMMIT' &,
    word(c.i,3)='TREE' & words(c.i)=4 then,
    tree=translate(word(c.i,4))
 if c.i='M175 PACK INFO PASS' then cpass=cpass+1
end
if ctype\=1 | length(tree)\=40 |,
   verify(tree,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 | cpass\=1 then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'M176 COMMIT TREE CROSSCHECK FAIL'
 exit 8
end
say 'M176 ROOT TREE' tree

drop w.
w.0=0
'PIPE CMS GITPTRE WALK' tree '| STEM w.'
wrc=rc
'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
if wrc\=0 then do
 do i=1 to w.0
  say w.i
 end
 say 'M176 TREE WALK FAIL RC' wrc
 exit 8
end
root=''
trees=''
blobs=''
links=''
entries=''
verified=''
itotal=''
pass=0
do i=1 to w.0
 say w.i
 if word(w.i,1)='TREE' & word(w.i,2)='CLOSURE' &,
    word(w.i,3)='ROOT' & words(w.i)=4 then,
    root=translate(word(w.i,4))
 if word(w.i,1)='TREE' & word(w.i,2)='CLOSURE' &,
    word(w.i,3)='TREES' & word(w.i,5)='BLOBS' &,
    word(w.i,7)='GITLINKS' & words(w.i)=8 then do
  trees=word(w.i,4)
  blobs=word(w.i,6)
  links=word(w.i,8)
 end
 if word(w.i,1)='TREE' & word(w.i,2)='CLOSURE' &,
    word(w.i,3)='ENTRIES' & word(w.i,5)='VERIFIED' &,
    words(w.i)=6 then do
  entries=word(w.i,4)
  verified=word(w.i,6)
 end
 if word(w.i,1)='TREE' & word(w.i,2)='CLOSURE' &,
    word(w.i,3)='INDEX' & word(w.i,4)='TOTAL' &,
    words(w.i)=7 then itotal=word(w.i,5)
 if w.i='M176 TREE CLOSURE PASS' then pass=pass+1
end
if root\=tree | datatype(trees,'W')\=1 |,
   datatype(blobs,'W')\=1 | datatype(links,'W')\=1 |,
   datatype(entries,'W')\=1 | datatype(verified,'W')\=1 |,
   trees<1 | verified\=trees+blobs |,
   entries<blobs+trees-1+links | itotal\=mobs | pass\=1 then do
 say 'M176 TREE CLOSURE CROSSCHECK FAIL'
 exit 8
end
say 'M176 TREE CLOSURE CROSSCHECK PASS'
say 'M176 TREES' trees 'BLOBS' blobs 'GITLINKS' links
say 'M176 ENTRIES' entries 'VERIFIED' verified
say 'M176 LIVE ROOT TREE CLOSURE TARGET GATE PASS'
exit 0

files.GIT12Q.ASSEMBLE:
GIT12Q   CSECT
          USING GIT12Q,12
          LR    12,15
          ST    14,RETADDR
*
* M12A: native VMCF TLSQuery probe against TCPIP.
* Proves VMCF AUTHORIZE, BEGINtcpIPservice, and TLSQuery.
*
          HNDEXT SET,EXTHAND,CODE=4001,ECB=ECB,ERROR=HNDERR
          XC    VPARM(40),VPARM
          LA    2,VPARM
          LA    4,INTBUF
          ST    4,16(2)
          LA    4,40
          ST    4,20(2)
          BAL   14,VMCFDIAG
          LTR   3,3
          BNZ   AUTHERR
*
* BEGINtcpIPservice: VMCF SEND, CALLCODE 101.
*
          XC    BEGDONE(1),BEGDONE
          XC    ECB(4),ECB
          BAL   14,INITREQ
          MVC   2(2,2),=X'0002'
          MVC   4(4,2),=F'2'
          LA    4,1
          ST    4,20(2)
          MVC   36(2,2),=X'0001'
          MVI   38(2),101
          BAL   14,VMCFDIAG
          LTR   3,3
          BNZ   BEGDIAG
          CLI   BEGDONE,1
          BE    BEGPOST
          WAITECB ECB=ECB
BEGPOST   CLI   BEGRC,0
          BNE   BEGFAIL
*
* TLSQuery: blank label asks whether SSL server is available.
* Keyring is blank because keyring selection is not available here.
*
          XC    PREPDONE(1),PREPDONE
          XC    QDONE(1),QDONE
          XC    ECB(4),ECB
          MVI   QREQ,X'40'
          MVC   QREQ+1(57),QREQ
          BAL   14,INITREQ
          MVC   2(2,2),=X'0003'
          MVC   4(4,2),=F'4'
          LA    4,QREQ
          ST    4,16(2)
          LA    4,58
          ST    4,20(2)
          MVI   38(2),128
          BAL   14,VMCFDIAG
          LTR   3,3
          BNZ   QDIAG
          CLI   PREPDONE,1
          BE    PREPOST
          WAITECB ECB=ECB
PREPOST   CLI   PREPRC,0
          BNE   PREFAIL
          XC    ECB(4),ECB
          CLI   QDONE,1
          BE    QPOST
          WAITECB ECB=ECB
QPOST     CLI   QUERYRC,0
          BNE   QFAIL
          LINEWRT DATA=(OKMSG,OKLEN)
          BAL   14,CLEANUP
          SR    15,15
          B     RETURN
*
AUTHERR   STC   3,OUTRC
          LINEWRT DATA=(AMSG,AMLEN)
          BAL   14,SHOWRC
          B     BADCLR
BEGDIAG   STC   3,OUTRC
          LINEWRT DATA=(BDMSG,BDLEN)
          BAL   14,SHOWRC
          B     BADCLN
BEGFAIL   MVC   OUTRC(1),BEGRC
          LINEWRT DATA=(BMSG,BMLEN)
          BAL   14,SHOWRC
          B     BADCLN
QDIAG     STC   3,OUTRC
          LINEWRT DATA=(QDMSG,QDLEN)
          BAL   14,SHOWRC
          B     BADCLN
PREFAIL   MVC   OUTRC(1),PREPRC
          LINEWRT DATA=(PMSG,PMLEN)
          BAL   14,SHOWRC
          B     BADCLN
QFAIL     MVC   OUTRC(1),QUERYRC
          LINEWRT DATA=(QMSG,QMLEN)
          BAL   14,SHOWRC
          B     BADCLN
HNDERR    LINEWRT DATA=(HMSG,HMLEN)
          LA    15,4
          B     RETURN
BADCLN    BAL   14,CLEANUP
BADCLR    HNDEXT CLR,CODE=4001
          LA    15,4
RETURN    L     14,RETADDR
          BR    14
*
* Initialize common TCPIP VMCF request fields.
*
INITREQ   ST    14,SUBRET
          XC    VPARM(40),VPARM
          MVC   8(8,2),=CL8'TCPIP'
          L     14,SUBRET
          BR    14
*
* Execute DIAGNOSE X'68'. R2 -> VMCF parm, R3 returns CP code.
*
VMCFDIAG  ST    14,SUBRET
          DC    X'83230068'
          L     14,SUBRET
          BR    14
*
* VMCF X'4001' handler. CP has already stored INTBUF.
* Do no I/O here. Save only the completion state needed by M12A.
*
EXTHAND   CLI   INTBUF+38,101
          BNE   EXQ
          MVC   BEGRC(1),INTBUF+39
          MVI   BEGDONE,1
          B     EXDONE
EXQ       CLI   INTBUF+38,128
          BNE   EXQC
          TM    INTBUF,X'80'
          BZ    EXDONE
          MVC   PREPRC(1),INTBUF+39
          MVI   PREPDONE,1
          B     EXDONE
EXQC      CLI   INTBUF+38,33
          BNE   EXDONE
          MVC   QUERYRC(1),INTBUF+39
          MVI   QDONE,1
EXDONE    SR    15,15
          BR    14
*
* Best-effort cleanup: unauthorize VMCF and clear CMS handler.
*
CLEANUP   ST    14,CLNRET
          XC    VPARM(40),VPARM
          MVC   2(2,2),=X'0001'
          LA    2,VPARM
          BAL   14,VMCFDIAG
          HNDEXT CLR,CODE=4001
          L     14,CLNRET
          BR    14
*
* Display one-byte return code as two hexadecimal digits.
* OUTRC contains the byte.
*
SHOWRC    ST    14,SHRET
          XR    5,5
          IC    5,OUTRC
          LR    6,5
          SRL   5,4
          N     5,=F'15'
          N     6,=F'15'
          LA    7,HEXTAB
          AR    5,7
          AR    6,7
          MVC   HEXOUT(1),0(5)
          MVC   HEXOUT+1(1),0(6)
          LINEWRT DATA=(RCMSG,RCLEN)
          L     14,SHRET
          BR    14
          LTORG
OKMSG     DC    C'M12A TLSQUERY OK: SSL SERVER AVAILABLE'
OKLEN     EQU   *-OKMSG
AMSG      DC    C'M12A VMCF AUTHORIZE DIAG FAILED'
AMLEN     EQU   *-AMSG
BDMSG     DC    C'M12A BEGIN DIAG FAILED'
BDLEN     EQU   *-BDMSG
BMSG      DC    C'M12A BEGIN TCPIP FAILED'
BMLEN     EQU   *-BMSG
QDMSG     DC    C'M12A TLSQUERY DIAG FAILED'
QDLEN     EQU   *-QDMSG
PMSG      DC    C'M12A TLSQUERY PREPROCESS FAILED'
PMLEN     EQU   *-PMSG
QMSG      DC    C'M12A TLSQUERY COMPLETE FAILED'
QMLEN     EQU   *-QMSG
HMSG      DC    C'M12A HNDEXT SET FAILED'
HMLEN     EQU   *-HMSG
RCMSG     DC    C'RETURN CODE X'''
HEXOUT    DC    CL2'00'
          DC    C''''
RCLEN     EQU   *-RCMSG
HEXTAB    DC    C'0123456789ABCDEF'
          DS    0D
VPARM     DS    40C
          DS    0D
INTBUF    DS    40C
QREQ      DS    58C
ECB       DC    F'0'
BEGDONE   DC    X'00'
BEGRC     DC    X'00'
PREPDONE  DC    X'00'
PREPRC    DC    X'00'
QDONE DC    X'00'
QUERYRC   DC    X'00'
OUTRC     DC    X'00'
RETADDR   DS    F
SUBRET    DS    F
CLNRET    DS    F
SHRET     DS    F
          END   GIT12Q

GITBX8   CSECT
         USING GITBX8,12
         LR    12,15
         ST    14,RETADR
*
* M198: sealed LAST record-only FSREAD to NEW scratch A file.
* Reads and validates all eleven records BEFORE creating scratch.
* No writes or renames to original M173NET STAGE G1.
* GITVRAW DATA A1 must not already exist; FSOPEN NEW enforces it.
* M197 externally verifies canonical Git SHA1 of scratch output.
*
         LINEWRT DATA=(START,L'START)
         XC    CURIDX,CURIDX
         XC    TOTAL,TOTAL
         L     6,=F'3864789'
         ST    6,CURNO
RDLOOP   L     6,CURIDX
         C     6,=F'11'
         BNL   ALLREAD
         LA    4,RECSET
         LR    7,6
         SLL   7,6
         AR    4,7
         L     5,CURNO
         FSREAD 'M173NET STAGE G1',BUFFER=(4),BSIZE=64,                X
               RECFM=V,RECNO=(5),NOREC=1,FORM=E,ERROR=RDERR
         ST    0,READLEN
         LA    9,LENSET
         L     7,CURIDX
         SLL   7,2
         AR    9,7
         ST    0,0(9)
         L     7,CURIDX
         LTR   7,7
         BNZ   BODYCHK
         L     7,READLEN
         C     7,=F'9'
         BL    BADHDR
         CLC   RECSET(9),=C'OBJ 7736 '
         BNE   BADHDR
         B     NEXTREC
BODYCHK  L     7,READLEN
         C     7,=F'64'
         BH    BADBODY
         L     6,CURIDX
         C     6,=F'10'
         BE    LASTREC
         C     7,=F'64'
         BNE   BADBODY
         B     EVENCHK
LASTREC  LTR   7,7
         BZ    BADBODY
EVENCHK  LR    6,7
         N     6,=F'1'
         BNZ   BADBODY
         L     4,READLEN
         SRL   4,1
         A     4,TOTAL
         ST    4,TOTAL
         LA    6,RECSET
         L     7,CURIDX
         SLL   7,6
         AR    6,7
         L     7,READLEN
CHECKCHR CLI   0(6),C'0'
         BNL   DIGIT
         CLI   0(6),C'A'
         BNL   UPPER
         CLI   0(6),C'a'
         BL    BADBODY
         CLI   0(6),C'f'
         BNH   NEXTCHR
         B     BADBODY
UPPER    CLI   0(6),C'F'
         BNH   NEXTCHR
         B     BADBODY
DIGIT    CLI   0(6),C'9'
         BNH   NEXTCHR
         B     BADBODY
NEXTCHR  LA    6,1(6)
         BCT   7,CHECKCHR
NEXTREC  L     6,CURNO
         LA    6,1(6)
         ST    6,CURNO
         L     6,CURIDX
         LA    6,1(6)
         ST    6,CURIDX
         B     RDLOOP
ALLREAD  L     4,TOTAL
         C     4,=F'289'
         BL    BADBODY
         C     4,=F'320'
         BH    BADBODY
         FSCLOSE 'M173NET STAGE G1',ERROR=ICLERR
         LINEWRT DATA=(RDOK,L'RDOK)
*
* NEW fails if scratch already exists, even if wrapper raced.
* Only create on A1 after full input validation and input close.
*
         FSOPEN FSCB=OUTFSCB,OPENTYP=NEW,FORM=E,ERROR=OPENERR
         XC    CURIDX,CURIDX
WRLOOP   L     6,CURIDX
         C     6,=F'11'
         BNL   WRDONE
         LA    4,RECSET
         LR    7,6
         SLL   7,6
         AR    4,7
         LA    9,LENSET
         LR    7,6
         SLL   7,2
         AR    9,7
         L     5,0(9)
         FSWRITE FSCB=OUTFSCB,BUFFER=(4),BSIZE=(5),                    X
               RECFM=V,FORM=E,ERROR=WRERR
         L     6,CURIDX
         LA    6,1(6)
         ST    6,CURIDX
         B     WRLOOP
WRDONE   FSCLOSE FSCB=OUTFSCB,ERROR=OCLERR
         LINEWRT DATA=(WROK,L'WROK)
         SR    15,15
         B     RETURN
BADHDR   LINEWRT DATA=(HERR,L'HERR)
         B     CLOSEIN
BADBODY  LINEWRT DATA=(BERR,L'BERR)
         B     CLOSEIN
RDERR    LINEWRT DATA=(RERR,L'RERR)
CLOSEIN  FSCLOSE 'M173NET STAGE G1',ERROR=ICLERR
         B     BADRET
ICLERR   LINEWRT DATA=(ICERR,L'ICERR)
         B     BADRET
OPENERR  LINEWRT DATA=(OPERR,L'OPERR)
         B     BADRET
WRERR    LINEWRT DATA=(WRFAIL,L'WRFAIL)
         B     CLOSEOUT
OCLERR   LINEWRT DATA=(OCERR,L'OCERR)
         B     BADRET
CLOSEOUT FSCLOSE FSCB=OUTFSCB,ERROR=OCLERR
BADRET   LA    15,8
RETURN   L     14,RETADR
         BR    14
         LTORG
RETADR   DS    F
CURIDX   DS    F
CURNO    DS    F
READLEN  DS    F
TOTAL    DS    F
LENSET   DS    11F
RECSET   DS    CL704
OUTFSCB  FSCB  'GITVRAW DATA A1',BUFFER=RECSET,BSIZE=64,RECFM=V,       X
               FORM=E
START    DC    C'M198 READ ONLY STAGE LAST OBJECT BEGIN'
RDOK     DC    C'M198 LAST 11 STAGE RECORDS VERIFIED'
WROK     DC    C'M198 NEW DISPOSABLE OBJECT WRITE PASS'
HERR     DC    C'M198 STAGE HEADER INVALID'
BERR     DC    C'M198 STAGE BODY INVALID'
RERR     DC    C'M198 STAGE FSREAD FAILED'
ICERR    DC    C'M198 STAGE FSCLOSE FAILED'
OPERR    DC    C'M198 NEW SCRATCH OPEN FAILED'
WRFAIL   DC    C'M198 SCRATCH WRITE FAILED'
OCERR    DC    C'M198 SCRATCH CLOSE FAILED'
         END   GITBX8

*

         LTR   15,15

LEGACY_HELPERS.json.description: Verbatim historical sole-caller native staging, publish, OFS/REF delta, PACK checksum, and native inflate bridge EXECs. GITPZNAT/GITPNWLK and other runtime workers now inline their sole-caller logic; exact old helpers remain available to historical tests.

files.GITNBRG.EXEC:
/* M13S bounded native driver wrapper; fail closed until module exists. */
/* TOOBUF offset stages at most 65536 compressed bytes. */
/* GITNDRV MODULE must read GITNSTG DATA A, write GITNOUT DATA A */
/* and GITNRES DATA A: RESULT rc used decoded. */
parse upper arg command offset extra
if command \= 'TOOBUF' | extra \= '' |,
 datatype(offset,'W') \= 1 | offset < 0 then exit 4
address command
'STATE GITNDRV MODULE A'
if rc \= 0 then do
 say 'GITNBRG: GITNDRV MODULE is not installed'
 exit 12
end
'EXEC GITNSTG STAGE' offset 65536
if rc \= 0 | queued() < 2 then exit 8
parse pull staged
parse pull records
if staged < 6 | staged > 65536 | records < 1 then exit 8
/* Invalidate previous driver output so stale results cannot pass. */
'ERASE GITNRES DATA A'
'ERASE GITNOUT DATA A'
'GITNDRV'
if rc \= 0 then do
 say 'GITNBRG: native driver returned' rc
 exit 8
end
drop m.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITNRES DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 | m.0 \= 1 then exit 8
parse var m.1 tag status used decoded extra
if tag \= 'RESULT' | extra \= '' |,
 datatype(status,'W') \= 1 | status \= 0 |,
 datatype(used,'W') \= 1 | datatype(decoded,'W') \= 1 then exit 8
if used < 6 | used > staged | decoded < 0 | decoded > 65536 then exit 8
/* The driver has completed a zlib member; validate output before */
/* publishing it into the shared object buffer. */
'EXEC GITNOUT COMMIT' decoded
if rc \= 0 | queued() < 1 then exit 8
parse pull committed
if committed \= decoded then exit 8
queue used
queue decoded
exit 0
files.GITNOUT.EXEC:
/* Transactional native output: preflight then bounded bulk publish. */
parse upper arg command want extra
if command \= 'COMMIT' | extra \= '' |,
 datatype(want,'W') \= 1 | want < 0 | want > 65536 then do
 say 'Usage: GITNOUT COMMIT output-bytes-0-to-65536'
 exit 4
end
address command
/* Read in batches; reject malformed, short, oversized or extra data. */
copied=0
recno=1
do while copied<want
 batch=(want-copied+63)%64
 if batch>16 then batch=16
 drop r.
 'EXECIO' batch 'DISKR GITNOUT DATA A' recno,
  '(STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | r.0<1 | r.0>batch then exit 8
 do i=1 to r.0
  h=strip(r.i)
  if h='' | length(h)>128 | length(h)//2\=0 |,
   verify(h,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
  copied=copied+length(h)%2
  if copied>want then exit 8
 end
 recno=recno+r.0
end
/* Zero-byte native output may have no CMS DATA file at all. */
/* For nonempty output, reject trailing records before publication. */
checkextra=1
if want=0 then do
 'STATE GITNOUT DATA A'
 if rc\=0 then checkextra=0
end
if checkextra then do
 drop r.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITNOUT DATA A' recno '(STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc=0 & r.0>0 then do
  say 'GITNOUT: extra output records'
  exit 8
 end
 if rc\=0 & rc\=2 then exit 8
end
/* Preflight complete. Publish in 16-record batches. */
'ERASE GITOBUF DATA A'
i=1
do while i<recno
 batch=recno-i
 if batch>16 then batch=16
 drop r.
 'EXECIO' batch 'DISKR GITNOUT DATA A' i,
  '(STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | r.0\=batch then exit 8
 do j=1 to batch
  h=strip(r.j)
  if h='' | length(h)>128 | length(h)//2\=0 |,
   verify(h,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
  r.j=h
 end
 'EXECIO' batch 'DISKW GITOBUF DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 i=i+batch
end
m.1='META' want '-' 1
m.0=1
'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITOMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then exit 8
queue copied
exit 0
files.GITNSTG.EXEC:
/* M13P native adapter staging: bounded zlib input records. */
/* STAGE offset limit copies at most limit bytes into GITNSTG DATA A. */
/* Records are binary hex, at most 64 bytes each. No full PACK string. */
parse upper arg command offset limit extra
if command \= 'STAGE' | extra \= '' |,
 datatype(offset,'W') \= 1 | datatype(limit,'W') \= 1 then do
 say 'Usage: GITNSTG STAGE byte-offset max-bytes'
 exit 4
end
if offset < 0 | limit < 6 | limit > 65536 then exit 4
address command
drop m.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITPMETA PACK A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 | m.0 \= 1 then exit 8
parse var m.1 tag total tail final extra
if tag \= 'META' | extra \= '' | final \= 1 |,
 datatype(total,'W') \= 1 then exit 8
if offset >= total then exit 8
if tail \= '-' then do
 if length(tail) >= 128 | length(tail)//2 \= 0 |,
  verify(tail,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then exit 8
end
avail = total - offset
if avail > limit then avail = limit
'ERASE GITNSTG DATA A'
'ERASE GITNSMT DATA A'
nrec = 0
copied = 0
/* Read 16 contiguous PACK records per call instead of invoking */
/* GITPBUF once per 64-byte staging record. Bound RAM to 1024 bytes. */
do while copied < avail
 sourceoff = offset + copied
 first = sourceoff % 64 + 1
 within = sourceoff // 64
 take = avail - copied
 if take > 1024-within then take = 1024-within
 last = (sourceoff + take - 1) % 64 + 1
 batch = last - first + 1
 drop in.
 'EXECIO' batch 'DISKR GITPBUF PACK A' first,
  '(STEM IN. FINIS'
 if rc \= 0 | in.0 \= batch then exit 8
 joined = ''
 do i = 1 to batch
  h = strip(in.i)
  if h = '' | length(h) > 128 | length(h)//2 \= 0 |,
   verify(h,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then exit 8
  if i < batch & length(h) \= 128 then exit 8
  joined = joined || h
 end
 if length(joined) < (within+take)*2 then exit 8
 joined = substr(joined,within*2+1,take*2)
 drop r.
 r.0 = 0
 j = 1
 do while j <= length(joined)
  r.0 = r.0 + 1
  idx = r.0
  r.idx = substr(joined,j,128)
  j = j + 128
 end
 'EXECIO' r.0 'DISKW GITNSTG DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc \= 0 then exit 8
 nrec = nrec + r.0
 copied = copied + take
end
m.1 = 'META' offset copied nrec
m.0 = 1
'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITNSMT DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 then exit 8
queue copied
queue nrec
exit 0
files.GITODLT.EXEC:
/* M6N isolated OFS_DELTA resolver against pack context. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'APPLY' then do
   parse var rest current offhex delta extra
   offhex = translate(offhex)
   delta = translate(delta)
   if extra \= '' | datatype(current,'W') \= 1 | current < 0 |,
      offhex = '' | length(offhex) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(offhex,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 | delta = '' |,
      length(delta) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(delta,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITODLT APPLY current-position offset-hex delta-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   call decodeofs offhex
   if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   distance = result
   if distance <= 0 | distance > current then do
      say 'GITODLT: OFS_DELTA base precedes pack data'
      exit 8
   end
   basepos = current - distance
   call readbase basepos
   if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
   'EXEC GITDAPP APPLY' basedata delta
   exit rc
end

say 'GITODLT: unknown command' command
exit 4

readbase: procedure expose basetype basedata
   parse arg wanted
   drop in.
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITPCTX PACK A 1 (STEM IN. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then do
      say 'GITODLT: pack context unavailable'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   found = 0
   do i = 1 to in.0
      parse var in.i tag p t d extra
      if tag \= 'ENTRY' | extra \= '' then do
         say 'GITODLT: corrupt pack context record' i
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      if datatype(p,'W') \= 1 | p < 0 then do
         say 'GITODLT: corrupt pack position' i
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      if p = wanted then do
         found = found + 1
         basetype = t
         basedata = d
      end
   end
   if found = 0 then do
      say 'GITODLT: OFS_DELTA base position not found' wanted
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if found > 1 then do
      say 'GITODLT: duplicate OFS_DELTA base position' wanted
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if basetype \= 'BLOB' & basetype \= 'TREE' &,
      basetype \= 'COMMIT' & basetype \= 'TAG' then do
      say 'GITODLT: invalid base object type' basetype
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if length(basedata) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(basedata,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'GITODLT: invalid base object data'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return 'OK'

decodeofs: procedure
   parse arg data
   pos = 1
   call nextbyte data, pos
   if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   b = result
   pos = pos + 2
   value = b // 128
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      call nextbyte data, pos
      if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
      b = result
      pos = pos + 2
      value = (value + 1) * 128 + (b // 128)
      more = b >= 128
      if value > 9007199254740991 then do
         say 'GITODLT: offset too large for exact REXX arithmetic'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
   end
   if pos <= length(data) then do
      say 'GITODLT: trailing bytes after OFS_DELTA offset'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return value

nextbyte: procedure
   parse arg data, pos
   if pos + 1 > length(data) then do
      say 'GITODLT: truncated OFS_DELTA offset'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return x2d(substr(data,pos,2))
files.GITOFS.EXEC:
/* M6H isolated Git OFS_DELTA negative-offset parser. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'PARSE' then do
   parse var rest data extra
   data = translate(data)
   if data = '' | extra \= '' | length(data) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(data,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITOFS PARSE offset-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   pos = 1
   b = nextbyte(data,pos)
   if b = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   pos = pos + 2
   value = b // 128
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      b = nextbyte(data,pos)
      if b = 'ERROR' then exit 8
      pos = pos + 2
      value = (value + 1) * 128 + (b // 128)
      more = b >= 128
      if value > 9007199254740991 then do
         say 'GITOFS: offset too large for exact REXX arithmetic'
         exit 8
      end
   end
   if pos <= length(data) then do
      say 'GITOFS: trailing bytes after offset'
      exit 8
   end
   say 'DISTANCE' value
   say 'BYTES' (pos - 1) % 2
   exit 0
end

say 'GITOFS: unknown command' command
exit 4

nextbyte: procedure
   parse arg data, pos
   if pos + 1 > length(data) then do
      say 'GITOFS: truncated OFS_DELTA offset'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return x2d(substr(data,pos,2))
files.GITORES.EXEC:
/* M6L isolated OFS_DELTA base-position resolver. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'RESOLVE' then do
   parse var rest current offhex extra
   offhex = translate(offhex)
   if extra \= '' | datatype(current,'W') \= 1 | current < 0 |,
      offhex = '' | length(offhex) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(offhex,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITORES RESOLVE current-position offset-hex'

   call decodeofs offhex
   if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   distance = result
   if distance <= 0 | distance > current then do
      say 'GITORES: OFS_DELTA base precedes pack data'
      exit 8
   end
   basepos = current - distance
   say 'CURRENT' current
   say 'DISTANCE' distance
   say 'BASE-POSITION' basepos
   exit 0
end

say 'GITORES: unknown command' command
exit 4

decodeofs: procedure
   parse arg data
   pos = 1
   call nextbyte data, pos
   if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   b = result
   pos = pos + 2
   value = b // 128
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      call nextbyte data, pos
      if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
      b = result
      pos = pos + 2
      value = (value + 1) * 128 + (b // 128)
      more = b >= 128
      if value > 9007199254740991 then do
         say 'GITORES: offset too large for exact REXX arithmetic'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
   end
   if pos <= length(data) then do
      say 'GITORES: trailing bytes after OFS_DELTA offset'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return value

nextbyte: procedure
   parse arg data, pos
   if pos + 1 > length(data) then do
      say 'GITORES: truncated OFS_DELTA offset'

files.GITPSHA.EXEC:
/* M9C bounded reader-driven Git PACK SHA-1 verification. */
address command
parse upper arg command extra
if command \= 'VERIFY' | extra \= '' then do
   say 'Usage: GITPSHA VERIFY'
   exit 4
end

drop m.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITPMETA PACK A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 | m.0 \= 1 then do
   say 'GITPSHA: pack metadata not found'
   exit 8
end
parse var m.1 tag size tail final junk
if tag \= 'META' | junk \= '' | datatype(size,'W') \= 1 then do
   say 'GITPSHA: corrupt pack metadata'
   exit 8
end
if size < 20 | final \= 1 | tail \= '-' then do
   say 'GITPSHA: finalized pack with trailer required'
   exit 8
end

payload = size - 20
'MAKEBUF'
queue right(d2x(payload),8,'0')
offset = 0
do while offset < payload
   count = payload - offset
   if count > 64 then count = 64
   'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' offset count
   if rc \= 0 then do
      save = rc
      'DROPBUF'
      exit save
   end
   offset = offset + count
end
'GITSTRM'
if rc \= 0 then do
   save = rc
   'DROPBUF'
   exit save
end
pull digest
'DROPBUF'

'MAKEBUF'
'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' payload 20
if rc \= 0 then do
   save = rc
   'DROPBUF'
   exit save
end
if queued() < 1 then do
   'DROPBUF'
   say 'GITPSHA: pack trailer missing'
   exit 8
end
pull trailer
'DROPBUF'
trailer = translate(trailer)
digest = translate(digest)
if digest \= trailer then do
   say 'GITPSHA: pack checksum mismatch'
   say 'COMPUTED' digest
   say 'TRAILER ' trailer
   exit 8
end
say 'PACK SHA1' digest
exit 0
files.GITRDEL.EXEC:
/* M6K isolated REF_DELTA base resolver for CMS object storage. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

/* Loose objects may live on a disk other than A. */
objectfm = 'A'
'STATE GITMETA REPO A'
if rc = 0 then do
   drop odmeta.
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO A 1 (STEM ODMETA. FINIS'
   if rc = 0 & odmeta.0 >= 1 &,
      odmeta.1 = 'CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then do
      odseen = 0
      do odi = 1 to odmeta.0
         if word(odmeta.odi,1) = 'OBJECT-DISK' then do
            if words(odmeta.odi) \= 2 then exit 8
            odseen = odseen + 1
            objectfm = translate(word(odmeta.odi,2))
         end
      end
      if odseen > 1 | length(objectfm) \= 1 |,
         verify(objectfm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') \= 0 then exit 8
   end
end

if command = 'RESOLVE' then do
   parse var rest oid delta extra
   oid = translate(oid)
   delta = translate(delta)
   if extra \= '' | length(oid) \= 40 |,
      verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 | delta = '' |,
      length(delta) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(delta,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITRDEL RESOLVE base-oid delta-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   call readbase oid
   if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
   'EXEC GITDAPP APPLY' datahex delta
   exit rc
end

say 'GITRDEL: unknown command' command
exit 4

readbase: procedure expose datahex objectfm
   parse upper arg oid
   objfn = substr(oid,1,8)
   drop obj.
   'EXECIO * DISKR' objfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm '1 (STEM OBJ. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then do
      say 'GITRDEL: base object not found' oid
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if obj.0 < 3 | word(obj.1,1) \= 'OID' |,
      word(obj.2,1) \= 'TYPE' then do
      say 'GITRDEL: corrupt base object' oid
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if word(obj.1,2) \= oid then do
      say 'GITRDEL: stored base OID mismatch'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   datahex = ''
   if obj.0 = 3 & word(obj.3,1) = 'DATA' then do
      datahex = word(obj.3,2)
   end
   else do
      if word(obj.3,1) \= 'SIZE' then do
         say 'GITRDEL: base SIZE record missing'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      size = word(obj.3,2)
      if datatype(size,'W') \= 1 | size < 0 then do
         say 'GITRDEL: invalid base SIZE'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      do i = 4 to obj.0
         if word(obj.i,1) \= 'DATA' then do
            say 'GITRDEL: invalid base DATA record'
            return 'ERROR'
         end
         chunk = word(obj.i,2)
         if length(chunk) > 128 then do
            say 'GITRDEL: base DATA chunk too long'
            return 'ERROR'
         end
         datahex = datahex || chunk
      end
      if length(datahex) % 2 \= size then do
         say 'GITRDEL: base SIZE mismatch'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
   end
   if length(datahex) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(datahex,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'GITRDEL: invalid base DATA hex'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return 'OK'
